summary: RptMnuPlcSch_StudAssignSummary is a web control for generating student assignment summary reports in a placement scheduling system. It provides a configurable UI for filtering and including various report options, such as campus, department, program, cohort, contact info, shift schedules, internal comments, and multiple display controls. The system handles dropdown filtering, permissions, validations, and report generation workflow based on user session context.
purpose: To enable users (typically staff and supervisors) to generate customized student assignment summary reports for placements, allowing filtering and inclusion of specific information fields and presentation options.

workflows.name: Generate Student Assignment Summary Report
steps: User selects department, program, cohort, and campus from dropdowns.
Dropdowns are populated based on user session permissions.
User selects report options via checkboxes and radio buttons (e.g., include contact info, advanced info, internal comments, shift schedules, preceptor/DC info, PDF export mode, page breaks).
Program permissions checked for internal comment inclusion.
System validates input, including maximum allowed items.
System creates a PrintJobs.ReportStudentPlacementScheduleCreateJob with selected parameters.
Report is generated and exported as single PDF or individual files based on user selection.

business_rules: Field declarations are auto-generated and should be moved to code-behind files for modification.
Maximum include items enforced, with error messages if exceeded.
Program permissions determine if internal comments can be included.
Dropdowns populated only if not already populated, or on change events.
User session context determines available options and permissions.
validations: CustomValidator1 and CustomValidator2 for input validation.
Cancel data selection if UserSession is null.
calculations: Dynamic error messages utilizing PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS and course count.
conditions: If UserSession.AllowAllDepartments, list all departments; otherwise, filter by agency.
If UserSession.AllowAllPrograms, list all programs; otherwise, filter by department.
If selected program allows course leader view, enable internal comment checkbox.
Data binding occurs only if items not already loaded or on specific control events.
system_behavior: Dropdowns dynamically populate based on user permissions and selections.
Radio buttons determine PDF report format and page break options.
Checkboxes control inclusion of report fields such as student contact info, advanced info, internal comments, shift schedules, preceptor and DC info.
JavaScript setup for client-side interactivity and maximum include item enforcement.
Data source selection is cancelled if user session is not present.
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer for department, program, cohort data.
UserSession context for permissions and filtering.
exceptions: Input validation failures (e.g., exceeding MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS) trigger error messages and halt report generation.
Null UserSession cancels data source selection.
